title: Strong finite-time RPCD bound through dimension six
statement: For every unit-diagonal SPD A of dimension 1<=n<=6, fresh-permutation RPCD satisfies E||x_k||_A^2<=(1-rho_n mu)^k||x_0||_A^2, where rho=(1,1/2,2/3,1/2,3/5,1/2). Hence E||x_k||_A reaches relative error epsilon in at most n*ceil(2 log(1/epsilon)/(rho_n mu)) coordinate updates. For all n>=3, the same ingredients give the unconditional benchmark J_3>=(3mu/n)A^{-1}.
assumptions: Fresh independent uniform permutation each epoch
A is real unit-diagonal SPD and mu=lambda_min(A)
open_objections: The target-order conclusion is not yet proved for n>=7.
Euclidean distance introduces the usual condition-number prefactor.
No Lean formalization or external-human validation exists.
